description: A chronic cutaneous form of lupus that causes persistent inflammatory plaques and can lead to scarring and pigmentary change.
risk_factors: Smoking may be associated with more persistent disease

appearance.general: Well-defined round or coin-shaped plaques with scale, follicular plugging, scarring, and pigmentary change may occur, commonly on the face, scalp, or ears.

warning_signs: New scarring scalp lesions or extensive persistent lesions should be medically assessed.
prevention: Reduce ultraviolet exposure with protective clothing and sun protection.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss photosensitivity, scarring, and any symptoms suggesting systemic lupus involvement.
